correctness.rationale: The 36-vertex graph has A_2=A^2-5I and 4A_3=A^3-2A^2-9A+10I, and nonconstant adjacency eigenspace dimensions 16,10,9. For D_p=A_1+2^p A_2+3^p A_3, the only crossing is 4(3^p-2^p)-1 on the ten-dimensional (-1)-adjacency sector: p*=0.4219679707924...; other branches stay <0 by elementary inequalities including -3+4u^2-2u^3 <= -17/27 for u=2^(p/2)>=1. At critical p, the 6x6 rook row/column contrasts span exactly ten null directions; Gram rank 25, otherwise 35 below, and Schoenberg gives all-bandwidth Gaussian positivity. Independently reconstructed the Sylvester graph from 50-vertex Hoffman–Singleton and numerically checked matrices below/at/above p*. The finite experiment supplements the exact all-real-p proof.
